author: dl_mj12
quote: Despite how its advertised, this is NOT a game for Battlefield fans. The "love letter" to fans is more like a slap in the face. The game has no soul and has dropped most of its key pillars and lot of its features. Very basic features from previous are no longer present. Not including voice comms in 2021? It has the worst UI I've seen in 30 years of gaming. I'm terribly disappointed. I cannot overstate how embarrassed I would be if I worked for DICE and contributed to this mess. Well done champs, this is a huge step backwards for the series. One seriously disappointed fan.
